title: Flatness after local comparison of the prepared charts
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative ring, Cbar a commutative R-algebra with compatible R/(pi^2)-algebra structure, and pi in R. Let d be prepared Popescu data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation], with full lifting algebra D and partial chart D_k [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-partial-chart-dimension]. Suppose Ann_R(pi)=Ann_R(pi^2). Let q be a prime of D avoiding the image of a_k, let q_k be its inverse image in D_k and p its contraction to R [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. If T=(D_k)_{q_k} is flat as an R-module, then the canonical local ring homomorphism R_p to D_q is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. No assumption that pi lies in q is needed.

proof.text: Apply annihilator_element_flat_base_change at pi and pi squared to the assumed flat map R to T. Rewrite the base annihilator equality and map_pow to get Ann_T(pi)=Ann_T(pi squared).

Use the existing proved chart_comparison_bijective helper: the key identity kills the original equations, divisibility of the other chart equations by pi together with their pi-torsion and the annihilator equality kills the remaining equations. The surjective chartMap then induces a bijection of local rings. RingHom.Flat.of_bijective makes that comparison flat.

The contractions of q and q_k to R agree by chartMap.commutes. Give T its canonical R_p-algebra structure and verify the scalar tower by localRingHom_to_map. Apply Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization to the assumed R-flatness of T. Compose the resulting flat map R_p to T with the flat comparison and identify the composite with the canonical local map by localRingHom_comp and chartMap.commutes.

theorem chart_maps_flat_of_partial {R : Type a} {Cbar : Type c}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (hAnnR : Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)) =
      Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)))
    (qD : PrimeSpectrum d.liftingAlgebra) (k : Fin d.r)
    (hk : ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk d.definingIdeal
      (d.includeX (d.a k))) ∉ qD.asIdeal)
    (hpartial : Module.Flat R (d.chartLocal k qD)) :
    (Localization.localRingHom
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra) qD).asIdeal
      qD.asIdeal (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra) rfl).Flat
